frame: model frame in mm, not registered to a patient; +x left, +y posterior, +z superior; the trachea starts at (0, 0, 0)

generator.branch_angle_rule: 37 degrees at a symmetric fork, shifted by the minimum-work angle arccos((1 + a^4 - b^4) / (2 a^2)) of the child's (a) and its sibling's (b) diameter ratios minus arccos(2^(-1/3))
generator.plane_rotation_rule: normal distribution, mean 90 and standard deviation 41.6 degrees, clamped to 0..180 degrees; exactly 90 degrees at the trachea's fork
generator.sources: R2 C.4: diameter ratio and length / diameter, Montesantos 2016 Eq. 3 and 4; rotation between successive branching planes measured 88.1 +/- 41.6 degrees, Montesantos 2016; branching angle usually below 60 degrees, optimum 37.28 degrees, Montesantos 2016; trachea, Weibel

label: Model-generated airway

target_choice.rule: among the targets of generation target_gen with exactly one Two Compasses fork among the four forks of the route, the one with the largest margin at that fork; margin = (dot of the direction of the child off the route with t - dot of the direction of the child on the route with t) / |t|, t = pos_mm(target) - pos_mm(fork)
